entries.label: Signals where a high street crosses another street

sources.hierarchies: declared: a town's busiest junctions are where its high street is crossed; the city's street-hierarchy catalog ranks the high street above every street a town lays but the avenue
sources.legs: declared: a crossroads, where two streets cross and each approach has a straight movement; a junction of three legs keeps the control the city gives it
sources.plan: declared: the one fixed-time plan of the signal-plan catalog, two phases with a concurrent walk each, which the compiler checks against every crossing and conflict of the junction
sources.offset_s: declared: every derived signal starts its cycle at second 0 of the clock; no coordination between signals is derived
